title: Collaborative invention / website sequence

location.series: COLLINS / Figma / Nothing Great Is Made Alone case study
location.extent: Complete clip; PNG is midpoint poster

slide_intent: Connect an inviting headline to a concrete story because an abstract promise needs an example people can follow.
strategic_value: A narrated assembly story can make Figma’s relevance to diverse collaborators clearer before a product invitation.
demonstration: A tablet-like website presentation moves from a white headline page into blue-violet submarine construction scenes with contributor labels, then returns to the opening invitation.
practical_value: Use an illustrated progression to connect a website promise with an example and call to action.

content_islands.name: Opening page
content_islands.spec: Center the collaboration headline and invitation on white below a compact navigation bar.

content_islands.name: Story pages
content_islands.spec: Pair copy at left with an evolving submarine at right on blue-violet.

content_islands.name: Participants and conclusion
content_islands.spec: Add named contributor labels, resolve the submarine and return to the headline page.

reference_purposes.Application: The campaign is demonstrated as a website sequence with navigation, story sections and a call to action.
reference_purposes.Intent: The on-screen copy connects combining different skills with creating something new.
